user.t:
Phase 3 of the read-only "Hebbwise" research mission (open-source Claude Code plugin cutting AI coding agents' tokens, raising efficiency and answer quality).

Working dir: C:\Users\mariu\open source project. Read ./research/README.md (SOP), ./research/01-mesh-hebbian.md (22 Technique Entries + Negative results) and ./research/02-projects-plugins.md (11 Technique Entries + 6 Gaps; it defines path aliases SYNCED and RCT at lines 6-7).

Task A (small fix): in 02-projects-plugins.md around line 166 there is a citation `SYNCED/25f8f5b3-…/skills/token-shield/SKILL.md:176` with a literal ellipsis. Replace `25f8f5b3-…` with the full folder name `25f8f5b3-1ae9-451d-ba15-0a4c91650b5c` (as used at line 77 of the same file). Change nothing else in that file.

Task B: write ./research/03-techniques.md — merge and de-duplicate all mechanisms from 01 and 02 into ONE table with columns: technique | axis | evidence | source path | reuse cost.
- Every Technique Entry from 01 and 02 must appear exactly once (merge genuine duplicates into one row and list both sources; say which entries were merged in a short note under the table).
- axis: token / efficiency / quality (combinations allowed, e.g. "token, efficiency" — first one is the primary axis).
- evidence: measured / claimed / unverified — copy the tag from the source entry; do not upgrade. For measured rows include the key number briefly, e.g. "measured (−21% tokens)".
- source path: a real path:line copied from the source entry (use full ~/ paths, not the SYNCED/RCT aliases, so citations are self-contained).
- reuse cost: own code / adapt / build.
- Sort by evidence strength (measured, then claimed, then unverified), then by primary axis (token, efficiency, quality).
- Add a column or numbered ID so each row is referable (T01..Tnn), and a "from" column giving the source entry (e.g. 01#3, 02#5).
After the table, add a short "Negative results to respect" list (cite path:line, copied from 01/02) — rejected levers the plugin must NOT rely on.

Rules: read only except writing 03-techniques.md and the one-line fix in 02. No new claims, no invented APIs; only copy what 01/02 say. Report: row count, how many measured/claimed/unverified, and which entries were merged.
